reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (District of Columbia, focus year 2021)

    Question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant,
    does the law require they provide local government with notice?

    Key mapped statutes:
      - DC Code  42-3404.02(a) (2021): Before owner may sell, must give tenant opportunity
        to purchase via bona fide offer of sale (TOPA).
      - DC Code  42-3404.03 (2021): Owner shall provide the Mayor with a written copy
        of the offer of sale (by certified mail or filing with the Conversion and Sale Administrator).
      - DC Code  42-3404.02(d)(1)(A) (2021): If opportunity to purchase is not provided,
        owner shall provide tenants and the Mayor a written Notice of Transfer.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (jurisdiction / time)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

jurisdiction(district_of_columbia).
focus_year(2021).

local_government_actor(mayor_of_dc).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts: "landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

owner(o1).
tenant(t1).
housing_accommodation(ha1).

% The property is occupied by a tenant.
occupies(t1, ha1).

% The owner wants/intends to sell the occupied housing accommodation.
intends_to_sell(o1, ha1).

% No facts indicating an exempt transfer; treat as an ordinary planned sale.
transfer_exempt_under_42_3404_02_c2(_Owner, _Accommodation) :- fail.

% Helper predicate that succeeds iff the factual scenario as stated is satisfied.
scenario_statement :-
    owner(Owner),
    tenant(Tenant),
    housing_accommodation(HA),
    occupies(Tenant, HA),
    intends_to_sell(Owner, HA).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic duty predicates)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* DC Code  42-3404.02(a) (2021)
   Before an owner of a housing accommodation may sell the housing accommodation,
   the owner shall give the tenant an opportunity to purchase the housing accommodation
   at a price and terms that represent a bona fide offer of sale.
*/
statute_42_3404_02_a_opportunity_to_purchase_required(Owner, HA) :-
    intends_to_sell(Owner, HA).

/* DC Code  42-3404.03 (2021)
   The owner shall provide the Mayor with a written copy of the offer of sale
   (by certified mail or filing with the Conversion and Sale Administrator).
   We encode this as a duty that arises whenever the owner is required to make
   the offer of sale under  42-3404.02(a).
*/
statute_42_3404_03_duty_provide_offer_of_sale_copy_to_mayor(Owner, HA) :-
    statute_42_3404_02_a_opportunity_to_purchase_required(Owner, HA).

/* DC Code  42-3404.02(d)(1)(A) (2021)
   In addition to other notice required, if an opportunity to purchase is not provided
   under this section, the owner shall provide each tenant and the Mayor written notice
   ("Notice of Transfer") of the transfer.

   We encode a conditional duty: if a sale/transfer is proceeding AND the opportunity
   to purchase was not provided, then Notice of Transfer must be given to the Mayor,
   unless an explicit exemption applies (modeled here).
*/
statute_42_3404_02_d1a_duty_notice_of_transfer_to_mayor_if_no_opportunity(Owner, HA) :-
    intends_to_sell(Owner, HA),
    \+ opportunity_to_purchase_provided(Owner, HA),
    \+ transfer_exempt_under_42_3404_02_c2(Owner, HA).

% Scenario does not state the owner failed to provide the opportunity to purchase.
% Therefore, we do not assert opportunity_to_purchase_provided/2 or its negation as a fact.
% This predicate remains open-world: it succeeds only if explicitly asserted elsewhere.
opportunity_to_purchase_provided(_Owner, _HA) :- fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning: does local government notice duty exist in this scenario?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* A general predicate capturing when, under these statutes, an owner has a duty
   to notify the local government (the Mayor) in connection with a planned sale.

   We consider TWO independent notice pathways:
     (1) Provide Mayor a copy of the offer of sale ( 42-3404.03), which flows from
         the baseline duty to provide tenants an opportunity to purchase ( 42-3404.02(a)).
     (2) If the opportunity is not provided, provide a Notice of Transfer to the Mayor
         ( 42-3404.02(d)(1)(A)).
*/
duty_notify_local_government_of_sale(Owner, HA) :-
    statute_42_3404_03_duty_provide_offer_of_sale_copy_to_mayor(Owner, HA).

duty_notify_local_government_of_sale(Owner, HA) :-
    statute_42_3404_02_d1a_duty_notice_of_transfer_to_mayor_if_no_opportunity(Owner, HA).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (must be deterministic; Result is yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    duty_notify_local_government_of_sale(_Owner, _HA),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant, does the law require they provide local government with notice?
